title: Adaptive canary gating for VPC control plane upgrades
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary:
We need an automated, metrics-driven canary rollout framework and Terraform/IaC components to safely upgrade the control plane in Private (VPC) deployments. The goal is to reduce blast radius, detect regressions automatically, and provide deterministic rollback and remediation actions. This ticket implements the server-side orchestration, health gating rules, and Terraform module changes required to wire upgrades into the Private control plane operator.

Scope:
- Define a canary cohort model for private control planes (per-customer or per-cluster cohorts) and an adaptive gating algorithm that widens or aborts based on health signals.
- Implement new Terraform module inputs and outputs to support staged upgrades and cohort labeling for customer infra.
- Add control plane version annotations to cluster CRs and support preflight dry-run checks.
- Build an automated rollback path that includes partial rollbacks (cohort-by-cohort) and fallback to prior compatible model variants in hosted/dedicated pipelines where applicable.
- Integrate health checks and gating into Console rollouts UI hooks and runtime telemetry for fast incident response.

Design decisions and trade-offs:
- Cohort granularity: We'll target 3 cohort sizes by default (1% seed, 10% early, 100% final) but support custom cohort definitions per-customer via module flags. This balances speed vs safety for large fleets.
- Adaptive gating: Use a sigmoid-like gating curve driven by weighted signals (latency p95, error-rate, control plane reconciliation lag, control plane API success rate). Thresholds are configurable at project and org levels.
- Operator vs orchestration layer: The operator will expose versioned CR fields and readiness probes; orchestration (a separate rollout controller) will implement gating logic. This separation keeps operator simple and enables faster iteration on rollout policies.
- Terraform concerns: We will not change customers' existing state except to add a new optional "rollout_policy" block to modules. Default behavior is opt-in to avoid surprising customers.

Implementation plan (high level):
1) Schema and Module work (Terraform)
   - Add rollout_policy block to modules/private_controlplane module with fields: cohorts (list of maps as strings), health_signals (list), auto_rollback(boolean), dry_run(boolean).
   - Output controlplane_version_annotation and rollout_metadata for downstream orchestration.
   - Provide example usage and migration guide for existing customers.

2) Operator / CR changes
   - Add VersionedControlPlane CR fields: desiredVersion, stagedVersion, cohortAssignment, rolloutStatus.
   - Implement server-side preflight checks: image validity, schema compatibility, and quota checks.

3) Rollout controller (new component)
   - Implements adaptive gating algorithm, maintains cohort state, triggers upgrades via CR updates, and initiates rollbacks.
   - Exposes events to Console and emits structured traces to tracing infra and metrics to telemetry.

4) Health signals and observability
   - Define canonical metrics and log events used for gating: controlplane_reconcile_duration_seconds, controlplane_api_error_rate, grpc_call_errors, etc.
   - Add dashboards in Console and Grafana; create a canary alerting policy.

5) Tests and verification
   - Unit tests for gating algorithm and Terraform module validation.
   - Integration tests using patched private-controlplane in canary sandbox with synthetic load generator (controlled latency/error injections).
   - Run a fire-drill upgrade and rollback in staging for multiple cluster sizes.

Acceptance criteria:
- Terraform module changes merged and documented with examples in the infra repo.
- Operator CR changes merged and can be consumed by rollout controller.
- Rollout controller can execute a 3-stage canary on a sandbox fleet and will auto-abort on injected failure scenarios.
- Console shows rollout status per-customer and links to rollback actions.
- Postmortem playbook created and on-call runbook updated.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: False positives from noisy telemetry causing unnecessary rollbacks. Mitigation: use aggregated signals with smoothing windows and require multi-signal breach before abort.
- Risk: Terraform state drift after adding rollout metadata. Mitigation: default to opt-in and provide a migration tool that inspects state and labels cohorts without changing runtime resources.
- Risk: Long-running rollouts extend exposure window. Mitigation: provide "fast-fail" policies and max rollout duration cap per release.

Links and artifacts:
- Design spec (Confluence): https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INFRA/pages/Private+Canary+Gating+Design
- Example Terraform module usage: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/tree/main/modules/private-controlplane/examples/canary
- PoC rollout controller PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/controlplane/pull/412
- Sandbox test dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/CanaryRollouts

Notes:
- Coordinate with Solutions and CSM teams before enabling auto_upgrade for enterprise customers.
- Security review required because rollout controller will orchestrate image changes and may interact with KMS for secret access.
comments: 2025-10-07 - Aisha: Kickoff meeting with Infra, Platform, and Console teams. Agreed on separation of operator vs rollout controller. Action: Marcelo to write initial gating algorithm doc.
2025-11-02 - Marcelo: Drafted gating algorithm and shared benchmark data from 50 staging clusters. Early metrics suggest p95 latency and reconcile lag are strongest early indicators.
2025-11-20 - Design review: PM (Ravi Shah) requested cohort customization per-tenant and an explicit 'safety window' to avoid upgrades during calendar maintenance windows.
2025-12-10 - PR opened for Terraform module changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/378. Waiting on module tests in CI.
2026-01-15 - Integration test: sandbox canary run completed; injected 5% error rate caused an automatic abort at 10% cohort stage. Observability team validated alerting behavior.
2026-02-18 - Security: SRE security review questionnaire submitted. Pending KMS key access policy adjustments for rollout controller (task created: ENG-22560).
2026-03-11 - Marcelo: Rollout controller v0.2 deployed to staging cluster. Demo scheduled for 2026-03-18 with Console PM and Solutions team.
